entries.3db77ccec378ebb9: A fabless manufacturer that originated as a wholesaler, planning in-house cosmetics, cosmetic accessories, character goods, and more, and selling them to retailers and consumers.
entries.a826cafaa31084d5: This is a classification covering household goods including pet supplies, stationery, leisure goods and gift products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,258 million. Pet-related products continued to perform well.
entries.ca75c60d9c5d9a64: This is a classification covering make-up sundries, nail-care sundries, hair-care sundries and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥6,976 million. Sundries featuring characters performed well, but the company's decision not to introduce some products deemed unprofitable for certain mass retailers also had an impact.
entries.cd1225fcf5c9d3ac: This is a classification covering make-up cosmetics, nail-care cosmetics, hair-care cosmetics and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥8,850 million, the largest of the product categories handled. Face masks and hand creams featuring popular characters performed well, and cosmetics sales of Picomonte Japan Inc. also contributed.
